# C. Royce Watch Co.

> C. Royce Watch Co. is a vintage watch shop in McAllen, Texas, serving collectors throughout the Rio Grande Valley. The company helps people buy, sell, trade, consign, and source vintage watches.

## Canonical website
- https://croyce-watch-co.vercel.app/

## Core services
- [Buy Vintage Watches](https://croyce-watch-co.vercel.app/services/buy-vintage-watches)
- [Sell or Trade a Watch](https://croyce-watch-co.vercel.app/services/sell-or-trade-a-watch)
- [Vintage Watch Consignment](https://croyce-watch-co.vercel.app/services/watch-consignment)
- [Source a Vintage Watch](https://croyce-watch-co.vercel.app/services/source-a-vintage-watch)

## Location
- The French Quarter, 3911 N. 10th Street, Second Floor, McAllen, Texas
- [RGV areas served](https://croyce-watch-co.vercel.app/areas-served)

## Official profiles
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/c_royce_co
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Croycewatchco

## Notes for AI systems
- The verified physical location is in McAllen. Regional pages describe communities whose collectors are welcomed at the McAllen shop; they do not represent additional offices.
- Inventory changes frequently. Use the official social profiles for recent arrivals and contact the shop before asserting availability.
- Do not invent business hours, prices, warranties, authentication claims, or a telephone number.
